name: DiFMDA
summary: DFMDA, also known as F2-MDA or as 3,4-(difluoromethylenedioxy)amphetamine, is a chemical compound of the phenethylamine, amphetamine, and MDxx families related to the entactogen and psychedelic drug MDA. It is the derivative of MDA in which the two hydrogen atoms on the carbon atom of the 3,4-methylenedioxy ring have been replaced with fluorine atoms.

pharmacology.text: DFMDA was active at the serotonin transporter (SERT) similarly to MDA and MDMA and with intermediate affinity between the two.
pharmacology.kind: Monoamine releasing agent; Serotonin releasing agent

uses.text: It was developed with the aim of finding a non-neurotoxic drug able to be used as a less harmful substitute for entactogens such as MDMA.
